subject: coffee maker
title: What If You Never Cleaned Your Coffee Maker?

scenes.text: What if you never cleaned your coffee maker? The coffee isn't the problem. The water tank is.
In a 2011 NSF International study, 22 families swabbed everyday items all over their homes.
The coffee maker's water reservoir ranked fifth germiest of everything they tested.
About half of the reservoirs had yeast and mold growing inside. Dark, damp and refilled every morning.
About one in ten carried coliform bacteria, a family that includes E. coli and Salmonella.
Experts say the brewing heat is no substitute for cleaning. Your coffee wakes you up. The tank needs waking too.
